NHL — Weak Spots by Position

NBA — This Week's Schedule

Nov 9–15, all 51 games, one day at a time, Eastern time. Records are from the tracker above. B2B marks a team that also played the day before. Schedule is from the official NBA release and is subject to change.

NBA — Weak Spots by Position

For each game, how many points, rebounds, assists or threes the opponent gives up to guards (G), forwards (F) and centers (C), against the league average, plus the best player on the other side to target. ESPN box scores only label G / F / C, not PG or SG. Schedule is from the official NBA release, Nov 9–15, Eastern time.

NFL — Weak Spots by Position

How many yards, catches or TDs each defense gives up per game to QBs, RBs, WRs and TEs, against the league average, and the best player on the other side to target. WEAK = 8%+ more than average, TOUGH = 8%+ less. Projection = player's season average × (defense allowed ÷ league average). Players who are OUT/IR in the injury report are skipped. Based on Weeks 1–8 box scores (one game is ~7 per defense, so treat it as a tilt, not a lock).
